name: pricing-tiers
title: Pricing Tiers
description: A tiered pricing section that can take four looks: a banner grid, tinted gradient columns, staggered cards or printed receipts. Each shows plan names, prices, feature lists and a call to action.
use: A product landing page needs several pricing looks to choose from, or a tier comparison with a billing switch.
avoid: Four layouts share one file with colours baked into classes and dollar signs written in, so rebranding takes edits.
a11y: The switch is a labelled role switch, buttons show focus rings and reduced-motion transitions are disabled; feature ticks are decorative. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: On black, a small eyebrow tag sits under a serif headline with a Yearly and Monthly switch below it. Three bordered cards run side by side: Starter at $9, a taller Growth card carrying a blue Most popular ribbon at $39, and Enterprise marked Custom, each with a tagline, price and dark button.
behaves: Cards reveal one after another as the section scrolls in. The Yearly and Monthly switch rolls the price digits to the other figure, and the variant option swaps the whole layout while keeping the same plans and copy.
customise: Pass plans plus eyebrow, heading and subheading to PricingTiers and choose a variant. Each layout also has its own option, such as banner or badge, staggered or level, and tilted or straight receipts.
weight: light: A grid of static cards plus a short reveal keyframe and digit changes on billing only.
